title: Honest Interval Length at Balanced Truths for ATE with Unlabeled Treatment-Covariate Records
banked_reason: D0.5 BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: effective subfield, projected paper-score ceiling 6.6 < field threshold 7.4; not salvageable in scope. Math review passes; unresolved Ketz--McCloskey closest-prior positioning and inaccessible inherited annotation source retained as caveats.
gap_reasons: The unmatched wedge (N/n)^2<d<n√N and the narrow favorable-truth criterion constrain the package's broader econometric significance and projected score, despite fulfillment of its stated contract.

The frontier is a genuine, explicit honest-length contribution, but its positioning should compare the closest omitted honest-adaptation/nuisance-parameter interval result (Ketz--McCloskey, 2021) and state precisely why its sign-restricted regression setting neither supplies nor subsumes this finite-sample unknown-mass auxiliary-record causal frontier.

proof_attempt_summary: D0 independently developed the globally honest upper interval and normalized original-record all-procedure converse, proving a rate bracket and unrestricted consistency criterion. Maximality extended the matched-rate region to d <= (N/n)^2 or d >= n*sqrt(N); the intermediate wedge remains open. D0.5 math review passed, but the cold novelty gate capped the package at subfield (6.6 < 7.4); independent validity review confirmed downgraded banking, retaining the literature caveats. No F-stage Lean formalization, axiom audit, or acceptance is claimed.
tldr: With \(n\) independent complete records and \(m\) independent treatment-covariate records, put \(N=n+m\). The criterion \(H\) is the infimum of worst-case expected ATE interval length at exactly balanced truths, subject to finite ninety-percent coverage over the whole unknown-mass fixed-overlap binary observational class. The proved global upper and lower brackets yield \(H\asymp\min\{1,n^{-1/2}+\sqrt d/N^{3/4}\}\) whenever \(d\le(N/n)^2\) or \(d\ge n\sqrt N\). These branches overlap and cover every dimension for \(N\ge n^2\). A total conditional-sign bias certificate attains the upper comparison, and a normalized original-record converse applies to every interval rule. Across unrestricted resource sequences, the same criterion vanishes exactly when \(n\to\infty\) and \(d=o(N^{3/2})\). Within the matched regime, root-label precision holds exactly when \(d=O(N^{3/2}/n)\). A general matched intermediate profile remains unresolved in \((N/n)^2<d<n\sqrt N\) when \(N<n^2\).
gap: Regular annotation inference, full-class MSE and generic testing leave balanced-truth global honest length unevaluated. The original all-resource matched profile remains unsupported.
fill: A finite total certificate and normalized original-record converse target matched precision for \(N\ge n^2\), and exact unrestricted consistency of the same \(H\).
